question: Which portions of the bright and dark lunar fortnights must be avoided?
premises: The bright fortnight has an initial third portion.
The dark fortnight has a final portion.
Certain portions of lunar fortnights are to be avoided.
inference: One should avoid the first third of the bright fortnight or the last part of the dark fortnight.
plain_english: One should avoid the first third of the bright fortnight or the last part of the dark fortnight.
